notes: Form-specific, Shield Hero anime Seasons 3–4 only; power grades are independent NIGHT editorial proposals. Not a complete feat audit or official grading.

naofumi-shield-hero.scope: Naofumi Iwatani — Shield Hero / four-hero alliance
naofumi-shield-hero.basis: Highly developed Legendary Shield defense, binding and counterattacks; sustained front-line protection in major battles.
naofumi-shield-hero.limits: Offensive output is restricted; Wrath Shield attack modes, late-novel weapons and 0 Series are not depicted.

raphtalia-katana-hero.basis: Chosen Vassal Katana wielder, with lethal close combat, mobility and illusion techniques.
raphtalia-katana-hero.limits: This image does not depict an unverified later heavenly-emperor power state.

filo-filolial-queen.basis: Transformed queen candidate with major physical strength, speed and wind magic.
filo-filolial-queen.limits: Human form pictured; not proof of Fitoria-level power or a distinct beast-form card.

rishia-projectile-hero.scope: Rishia Ivyred — Hengen Muso / Projectile Hero
rishia-projectile-hero.basis: Mastered Hengen Muso and a Projectile Vassal Weapon recognizes her in combat.
rishia-projectile-hero.limits: Requires combat focus; does not automatically outrank every Cardinal Hero.

ren-sword-hero.basis: Legendary Sword wielder; improves through physical sword training and weapon mastery.
ren-sword-hero.limits: Not the strongest novel-era Ren, and no cursed-Greed form is shown.

motoyasu-empowered.basis: Legendary Spear Hero using additional enhancement methods, giving overwhelming offensive power.
motoyasu-empowered.limits: Conditions and unstable decision-making still affect real-world fights.

itsuki-bow-hero.scope: Itsuki Kawasumi — Bow Hero / curse recovery
itsuki-bow-hero.basis: Legendary Bow enables versatile long-range attacks and hero skills.
itsuki-bow-hero.limits: Still recovering from curse consequences; not his strongest later state.

melty-water-magic.basis: Trained royal water magician who supports allies and employs ranged magic.
melty-water-magic.limits: Political authority is not combat power; no speculative advanced spells.

eclair-swordswoman.basis: Disciplined sword fighter and instructor with documented victory over a weakened Ren.
eclair-swordswoman.limits: Sword skill in a duel does not make her stronger than late-story Ren.

myne-fire-magic.scope: Malty S Melromarc — Fire magic / adventurer
myne-fire-magic.basis: Uses fire magic and deception, but limited direct battle performance.
myne-fire-magic.limits: Manipulation, status and treachery are not supernatural fighting feats.

sadeena-orca-warrior.basis: Expert harpoon fighter with exceptional close-quarters skill and lightning magic.
sadeena-orca-warrior.limits: This costume portrays the arena-era warrior, not the later Vassal Harpoon Hero.

fohl-hakuko-fighter.basis: Dangerous demi-human brawler with formidable Hakuko strength and arena experience.
fohl-hakuko-fighter.limits: Vassal Gauntlet Hero abilities require a separate matching artwork.

atla-hengen-muso.basis: Exceptional sense of ki and precise Hengen Muso strikes able to challenge stronger opponents.
atla-hengen-muso.limits: Physical fragility and short-range conditions remain relevant.

syne-sewing-hero.basis: Versatile interworld hero who fights with scissors, thread, traps and her Sewing Set.
syne-sewing-hero.limits: Damaged weapon and uncertain energy reserves limit comparisons.

werner-shusaku.basis: Powerful avian demi-human lineage and impressive physical presence.
werner-shusaku.limits: Official profile emphasizes diplomacy; no confirmed high-level combat display.

jaralis-laio.basis: Force-oriented lion demi-human leader with significant physical potential.
jaralis-laio.limits: No reliable evidence here for Guardian Beast-level or awakened-form power.
